The main takeaway from our work is that

learning conversational machine learning can be framed as a reinforcement learning problem, and that reinforcement learning algorithms can be used to learn question-asking strategies that lead to faster learning of machine learning classifiers.

learning to ask questions in a conversational learning setting can be a viable strategy for learning machine learning models, particularly when the learning tasks are complex or the available supervision data is limited.
learning to ask questions in a conversation with a teacher can be an effective way to train a learner, even when the learner is not initially capable of learning from observations alone.
